description: This file defines the interface 'LiveSignalPub' which provides static and instance methods for publishing live signals using distributed pub/sub mechanisms. It includes references to relevant external classes and interfaces such as 'DistributedPub', 'Signal', 'Command', and 'Event'.

classes.name: LiveSignalPub
classes.description: An interface for publishing live signals such as commands, events, and messages in a distributed pub/sub system. Provides methods to instantiate the publisher in an actor context and access to various distributed pub channels.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of LiveSignalPub in the context of an Akka actor system.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Returns the distributed pub for live commands.

methods.name: event
methods.description: Returns the distributed pub for live events.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the distributed pub for messages.
